scenes.broll: Close view over a black wok on a gas hob in a sunny home kitchen: sliced red and yellow peppers, broccoli florets, sugar snap peas, sliced spring onions and strips of carrot glisten as a woman's right hand turns them with a wooden spatula. Only her hand and forearm are in frame, a rolled-up denim shirt sleeve, short unpainted nails. A smartphone leans against the white tiled splashback with its screen dark. Warm late-afternoon sun from a window on the left lights the rising steam and throws crisp shadows across the cream worktop. Vertical frame: the upper half is plain sunlit white tiled splashback, the wok sits just below the centre, the worktop edge fills the bottom. 35mm lens at f/5.6, the vegetables in sharp focus.
scenes.vo: Weight health isn’t one thing. So we don’t treat it like one.
scenes.broll_brief: a woman in her late forties cooking a colourful vegetable stir fry in a sunny home kitchen, phone propped on the worktop
scenes.motion: Steam rises slowly from the wok and the wooden spatula turns the vegetables once, gently. The phone stays still. The camera pushes in very slowly.
